# NUP fixture

`reference.nup` was generated by the independent `a55uka/nup` tool at commit
`a4840f06c94ddeb414eea5b33c9704ffe995f11c` from the tool's own README, license,
and Python source files. The tool is MIT-licensed; its license is included as
`LICENSE.txt`.

The pack command created base, update, and add-on packages with raw and Zstandard
payloads:

```text
nup pack <source> reference.nup --title-id 0100000000000000 --display-version 1.0.0 --name "NUP reference test" --publisher "a55uka/nup" --quiet
```

The reference tool's `verify` command passed. The sample SHA-256 is
`3b06f05be929fc1fd0554c0fe2cbdc321f75d118b45861fd8d0de27cc8494764`.
